Vera (Infra PM): quick follow-up from the all-hands: folks asked whether APAC overflow during holidays routes to preemptibles or a reserve first. can we state the exact order and any thresholds? cc @Noah :question:

Noah (VP Infra): short answer: we use a small regional reserve (warm-reserve) before opening preemptibles. routing order: regional-warm -> warm-reserve -> regional-preempt -> remote. thresholds below. :point_down:

Ivy (SRE): ops detail: preempt detection = `preempt_rate > 0.17` over a 60s window -> region marked volatile. when volatile, we temporarily raise `min_warm` by +1 for premium routes for 10m. warm-reserve allocations consume burst credits if assigned.

Uma (Platform): console/API note: we'll surface `route.metrics.warm_reserve_alloc` and `route.metrics.spill_tag` next week. API flag `allocate_from_reserve=true` will allow routes to opt in. mockups coming Tuesday.

Kai (Support): one-liner for CS please (non-technical) so we can respond quickly when customers see brief latency blips.

Noah (VP Infra): suggested: "During short regional demand spikes we use a small local reserve to protect latency-sensitive traffic; if that fills we briefly use lower-cost capacity to keep requests flowing." feel free to shorten.

Vera (Infra PM): action items: 1) Uma -> post console mock + API name 2) Ivy -> share preempt dashboard link & sim command (`infra/tools/preempt-sim --region=apac1 --spike=0.35 --dur=180`) 3) Kai -> add CS line to templates. target: EOD Wed.

infra-bot: deploy-bot queued autoscaler/v2 -> staging @ 2025-03-12T09:00:00Z. monitors: warm-reserve-util, preempt-rate. :robot_face:

Vera (Infra PM): thanks team, I'll consolidate and post the short FAQ to the all-hands follow-up doc. :white_check_mark:
